dishes.name: Nürnberger Rostbratwurst
dishes.desc: Thumb-sized pork sausage with a protected origin, grilled over beechwood and served in threes, sixes or twelves.

dishes.name: Nürnberger Lebkuchen
dishes.desc: Soft spiced gingerbread baked on a wafer, made in Nürnberg since the 14th century with a protected origin.

dishes.name: Franconian carp
dishes.desc: Carp from the ponds of the Aischgrund, served baked or fried in autumn and winter. A mainstay of Middle Franconian inns.

dishes.name: Franconian Sauerbraten
dishes.desc: Beef marinated for days in vinegar and spices, often with a sauce thickened with Lebkuchen. Served with dumplings.

dishes.name: Blaue Zipfel
dishes.desc: Bratwürste simmered in a spiced vinegar and onion broth. A Nürnberg pub classic.
